# Differential expression of PA14 quorum-sensing mutants vs wild type
#
# Reads data/rnaseq/counts.csv, samples.csv and annotation.csv and writes
#   results/rnaseq_differential_expression.csv  only the calls passing
#                                               FDR < 0.05 and |log2FC| >= 1,
#                                               one row per gene and contrast
#   results/rnaseq_de_summary.csv               genes changed per contrast
#   results/rnaseq_mutant_overlap.csv           overlap of the two single mutants,
#                                               double-mutant sharing and additivity
#   results/rnaseq_sensitivity.csv              per-medium fits and default Cook's filter
#   results/rnaseq_top_genes.csv                strongest genes per contrast
#   results/rnaseq_differential_expression.png  four-panel figure
#
# Run from the project root:  Rscript analysis/rnaseq_differential_expression.R
#
# Design: one DESeq2 model on all 36 samples with the twelve medium x strain
# groups (a saturated model equivalent to medium * strain). Each mutant is then
# compared with wild type within each medium by a group contrast. Dispersion is
# estimated across all groups, which is more stable than three separate 12-sample
# fits; the per-medium sensitivity fit is written to rnaseq_sensitivity.csv.
#
# The annotation file has unquoted commas inside some product names, so it is
# parsed by splitting each line on its first two commas rather than with read.csv.
#
# A gene is called changed when padj < 0.05 and |log2FoldChange| >= 1 (two-fold).
# Cook's distance outliers are flagged but not removed: with three replicates the
# default filter removes five genes from every contrast, including rhlI and lasB.
# Turning it off changes each contrast's changed-gene count by at most four genes.

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
})

dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)

mutant_labels <- c("1" = "Wild type", "97" = "ΔrhlI", "98" = "ΔlasI",
                   "99" = "ΔlasIΔrhlI")
mutant_short <- c("97" = "ΔrhlI\n(97)", "98" = "ΔlasI\n(98)",
                  "99" = "ΔlasIΔrhlI\n(99)")
media_short <- c("MMGluFeMinus" = "MMGlu Fe−",
                 "MMGluFePlus"  = "MMGlu Fe+",
                 "Succinate"    = "Succinate")

## ---- data ----------------------------------------------------------------

counts <- read.csv("data/rnaseq/counts.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
samples <- read.csv("data/rnaseq/samples.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

if (!setequal(colnames(counts), samples$AzentaName)) {
  stop("Count columns and sample sheet names do not match")
}
counts <- counts[, samples$AzentaName]

parse_annotation <- function(path) {
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  parts <- strsplit(lines[-1], ",", fixed = TRUE)
  data.frame(
    locus_tag = vapply(parts, `[`, "", 1),
    gene      = vapply(parts, function(x) if (length(x) >= 2) x[2] else "", ""),
    product   = vapply(parts, function(x) if (length(x) >= 3) {
      paste(x[-(1:2)], collapse = ",")
    } else "", ""),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

annot <- parse_annotation("data/rnaseq/annotation.csv")
annot <- annot[!duplicated(annot$locus_tag), ]
rownames(annot) <- annot$locus_tag

if (any(!rownames(counts) %in% annot$locus_tag)) {
  stop("Some count rows have no annotation")
}

meta <- samples
rownames(meta) <- meta$AzentaName
meta$Strain <- factor(meta$Strain, levels = c(1, 97, 98, 99))
meta$Media <- factor(meta$Media,
                     levels = c("MMGluFeMinus", "MMGluFePlus", "Succinate"))
group_levels <- as.vector(t(outer(levels(meta$Media), levels(meta$Strain),
                                  paste, sep = "_")))
meta$Group <- factor(paste(meta$Media, meta$Strain, sep = "_"),
                     levels = group_levels)

## ---- model ---------------------------------------------------------------

keep <- rowSums(counts >= 10) >= 3
counts_keep <- counts[keep, ]
cat("Genes with >= 10 counts in >= 3 samples:", nrow(counts_keep), "of",
    nrow(counts), "\n")

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_keep, colData = meta,
                              design = ~ Group)
dds <- DESeq(dds, fitType = "local", quiet = TRUE)

# Same Cook's distance rule DESeq2 applies inside results(); used only to flag.
p_model <- ncol(model.matrix(design(dds), colData(dds)))
n_samples <- ncol(dds)
cooks_cutoff <- qf(0.99, p_model, n_samples - p_model)
cooks <- assays(dds)[["cooks"]]
cooks_outlier <- apply(cooks, 1, function(x) any(x > cooks_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE))
cat("Cook's outlier cutoff:", round(cooks_cutoff, 2), "- flagged genes:",
    sum(cooks_outlier), "\n")

extract_contrast <- function(medium, mut) {
  con <- c("Group", paste(medium, mut, sep = "_"), paste(medium, "1", sep = "_"))
  r <- results(dds, contrast = con, alpha = 0.05, cooksCutoff = FALSE)
  rs <- suppressMessages(lfcShrink(dds, contrast = con, type = "normal"))
  d <- data.frame(
    comparison   = paste(medium, mut, sep = "_"),
    media        = medium,
    strain       = mut,
    mutant       = unname(mutant_labels[mut]),
    locus_tag    = rownames(r),
    gene         = annot[rownames(r), "gene"],
    product      = annot[rownames(r), "product"],
    baseMean     = r$baseMean,
    log2FC       = r$log2FoldChange,
    lfcSE        = r$lfcSE,
    stat         = r$stat,
    pvalue       = r$pvalue,
    padj         = r$padj,
    log2FC_shrunk = rs$log2FoldChange,
    lfcSE_shrunk  = rs$lfcSE,
    cooks_outlier = unname(cooks_outlier[rownames(r)]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  d$significant_FDR05 <- !is.na(d$padj) & d$padj < 0.05
  d$significant_2fold <- d$significant_FDR05 & abs(d$log2FC) >= 1
  d$direction <- ifelse(!d$significant_2fold, "not changed",
                        ifelse(d$log2FC > 0, "up", "down"))
  d
}

res_list <- list()
for (medium in levels(meta$Media)) {
  for (mut in levels(meta$Strain)[-1]) {
    key <- paste(medium, mut, sep = "_")
    res_list[[key]] <- extract_contrast(medium, mut)
  }
}

de <- do.call(rbind, res_list)
rownames(de) <- NULL

# The written table is compact: only the calls passing FDR < 0.05 and
# |log2FC| >= 1, with the columns used for interpretation.
de_out <- de[de$significant_2fold,
             c("comparison", "media", "strain", "mutant", "locus_tag", "gene",
               "product", "baseMean", "log2FC", "lfcSE", "pvalue", "padj",
               "log2FC_shrunk", "direction", "cooks_outlier")]
num_cols <- c("baseMean", "log2FC", "lfcSE", "pvalue", "padj", "log2FC_shrunk")
de_out[num_cols] <- lapply(de_out[num_cols], function(x) signif(x, 6))
write.csv(de_out, "results/rnaseq_differential_expression.csv",
          row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

## ---- per-contrast summary -------------------------------------------------

de_summary <- de %>%
  group_by(comparison, media, strain, mutant) %>%
  summarise(
    genes_tested    = sum(!is.na(padj)),
    DE_FDR05        = sum(significant_FDR05),
    DE_FDR05_2fold  = sum(significant_2fold),
    up              = sum(direction == "up"),
    down            = sum(direction == "down"),
    cooks_outlier_genes = sum(cooks_outlier),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(media, levels(meta$Media)), match(strain, levels(meta$Strain)))

write.csv(de_summary, "results/rnaseq_de_summary.csv",
          row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

## ---- overlap of the single mutants and double-mutant sharing --------------

sig_loci <- function(key) {
  d <- res_list[[key]]
  d$locus_tag[d$significant_2fold]
}

universe <- sum(!is.na(res_list[[1]]$padj))

overlap_rows <- lapply(levels(meta$Media), function(m) {
  d97 <- res_list[[paste(m, "97", sep = "_")]]
  d98 <- res_list[[paste(m, "98", sep = "_")]]
  d99 <- res_list[[paste(m, "99", sep = "_")]]
  a <- sig_loci(paste(m, "97", sep = "_"))
  b <- sig_loci(paste(m, "98", sep = "_"))
  d <- sig_loci(paste(m, "99", sep = "_"))
  both <- intersect(a, b)
  union_ab <- union(a, b)

  same_direction <- sum(
    sign(d97$log2FC[match(both, d97$locus_tag)]) ==
      sign(d98$log2FC[match(both, d98$locus_tag)])
  )

  pred <- d97$log2FC + d98$log2FC
  ok <- !is.na(pred) & !is.na(d99$log2FC) & !is.na(d99$padj) & d99$padj < 0.05
  fit <- lm(d99$log2FC[ok] ~ pred[ok])

  data.frame(
    media               = m,
    n97                 = length(a),
    n98                 = length(b),
    both                = length(both),
    only97              = length(setdiff(a, b)),
    only98              = length(setdiff(b, a)),
    jaccard             = length(both) / length(union_ab),
    same_direction      = same_direction,
    p_overlap           = phyper(length(both) - 1, length(a),
                                 universe - length(a), length(b),
                                 lower.tail = FALSE),
    lfc_cor_all         = cor(d97$log2FC, d98$log2FC, use = "complete.obs"),
    lfc_cor_union       = cor(d97$log2FC[match(union_ab, d97$locus_tag)],
                              d98$log2FC[match(union_ab, d98$locus_tag)]),
    n99                 = length(d),
    n99_in_both         = sum(d %in% both),
    n99_in_one          = sum(d %in% union_ab & !d %in% both),
    n99_new             = sum(!d %in% union_ab),
    additivity_n        = sum(ok),
    additivity_slope    = unname(coef(fit)[2]),
    additivity_r2       = summary(fit)$r.squared,
    additivity_cor      = cor(pred[ok], d99$log2FC[ok]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
overlap <- do.call(rbind, overlap_rows)
write.csv(overlap, "results/rnaseq_mutant_overlap.csv",
          row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

## ---- sensitivity of the per-contrast calls --------------------------------
# Alternative 1: fit each medium separately (12 samples, design ~ Strain).
# Alternative 2: keep the combined model but use DESeq2's default Cook's filter.

sens_rows <- lapply(names(res_list), function(key) {
  d_primary <- res_list[[key]]
  m <- d_primary$media[1]
  mut <- d_primary$strain[1]
  idx <- meta$Media == m
  ms <- droplevels(meta[idx, ])
  d_alt <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_keep[, idx],
                                  colData = ms, design = ~ Strain)
  d_alt <- DESeq(d_alt, fitType = "local", quiet = TRUE)
  r_alt <- results(d_alt, contrast = c("Strain", mut, "1"),
                   alpha = 0.05, cooksCutoff = FALSE)
  sig_alt <- !is.na(r_alt$padj) & r_alt$padj < 0.05 & abs(r_alt$log2FoldChange) >= 1

  con <- c("Group", paste(m, mut, sep = "_"), paste(m, "1", sep = "_"))
  r_def <- results(dds, contrast = con, alpha = 0.05)
  sig_def <- !is.na(r_def$padj) & r_def$padj < 0.05 & abs(r_def$log2FoldChange) >= 1

  sig_primary <- d_primary$significant_2fold
  p_locus <- d_primary$locus_tag

  data.frame(
    comparison            = key,
    primary_DE            = sum(sig_primary),
    per_medium_DE         = sum(sig_alt),
    per_medium_shared     = sum(sig_primary & sig_alt),
    per_medium_jaccard    = sum(sig_primary & sig_alt) / sum(sig_primary | sig_alt),
    per_medium_lfc_cor    = cor(d_primary$log2FC,
                                r_alt$log2FoldChange[match(p_locus, rownames(r_alt))],
                                use = "complete.obs"),
    cooks_default_DE      = sum(sig_def),
    cooks_default_shared  = sum(sig_primary & sig_def),
    cooks_default_jaccard = sum(sig_primary & sig_def) / sum(sig_primary | sig_def),
    cooks_default_lfc_cor = cor(d_primary$log2FC,
                                r_def$log2FoldChange[match(p_locus, rownames(r_def))],
                                use = "complete.obs"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
sensitivity <- do.call(rbind, sens_rows)
write.csv(sensitivity, "results/rnaseq_sensitivity.csv",
          row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

## ---- strongest genes per contrast ----------------------------------------

top_rows <- list()
for (key in names(res_list)) {
  d <- res_list[[key]]
  sig <- d[d$significant_2fold, ]
  by_padj <- head(sig[order(sig$padj), ], 10)
  by_fold <- sig[sig$baseMean >= 100, ]
  by_fold <- head(by_fold[order(-abs(by_fold$log2FC)), ], 10)

  add_rank <- function(x, how) {
    if (nrow(x) == 0) return(NULL)
    data.frame(
      rank_by   = how,
      rank      = seq_len(nrow(x)),
      comparison = key,
      media     = x$media,
      strain    = x$strain,
      mutant    = x$mutant,
      locus_tag = x$locus_tag,
      gene      = x$gene,
      product   = x$product,
      baseMean  = x$baseMean,
      log2FC    = x$log2FC,
      padj      = x$padj,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  top_rows[[paste(key, "padj", sep = "_")]] <- add_rank(by_padj, "padj")
  top_rows[[paste(key, "fold", sep = "_")]] <- add_rank(by_fold, "abs_log2FC")
}
top_genes <- do.call(rbind, top_rows)
rownames(top_genes) <- NULL
top_genes$baseMean <- signif(top_genes$baseMean, 6)
top_genes$log2FC <- signif(top_genes$log2FC, 6)
top_genes$padj <- signif(top_genes$padj, 6)
write.csv(top_genes, "results/rnaseq_top_genes.csv",
          row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

## ---- figure ---------------------------------------------------------------

# A. genes changed per contrast, split by direction
bar_df <- de_summary %>%
  select(comparison, media, strain, mutant, up, down) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(up, down), names_to = "direction", values_to = "n")
bar_df$direction <- factor(bar_df$direction, levels = c("up", "down"),
                           labels = c("Up", "Down"))
bar_df$mutant_f <- factor(mutant_short[bar_df$strain],
                          levels = mutant_short[c("97", "98", "99")])
bar_df$media_f <- factor(media_short[bar_df$media],
                         levels = media_short[levels(meta$Media)])
de_summary$mutant_f <- factor(mutant_short[de_summary$strain],
                              levels = mutant_short[c("97", "98", "99")])
de_summary$media_f <- factor(media_short[de_summary$media],
                             levels = media_short[levels(meta$Media)])

pA <- ggplot(bar_df, aes(mutant_f, n, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72) +
  geom_text(data = de_summary,
            aes(x = mutant_f, y = DE_FDR05_2fold, label = DE_FDR05_2fold),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = -0.35, size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ media_f, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Up = "#c0392b", Down = "#2c6fbb"),
                    name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "Genes changed (FDR < 0.05, |log2FC| ≥ 1)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey94", colour = NA),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# B. overlap of the two single mutants
ov_long <- overlap %>%
  select(media, both, only97, only98) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(both, only97, only98),
                      names_to = "category", values_to = "n")
ov_long$category <- factor(ov_long$category,
                           levels = c("both", "only97", "only98"),
                           labels = c("Both mutants", "ΔrhlI only", "ΔlasI only"))
ov_long$media_f <- factor(media_short[ov_long$media],
                          levels = media_short[levels(meta$Media)])

pB <- ggplot(ov_long, aes(media_f, n, fill = category)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Both mutants" = "#6a3d9a",
                               "ΔrhlI only" = "#e08214",
                               "ΔlasI only" = "#3288bd"),
                    name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Genes changed in 97 and/or 98") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# C. log2 fold-change agreement between the single mutants
scatter_rows <- lapply(levels(meta$Media), function(m) {
  d97 <- res_list[[paste(m, "97", sep = "_")]]
  d98 <- res_list[[paste(m, "98", sep = "_")]]
  cat <- ifelse(d97$significant_2fold & d98$significant_2fold, "Both mutants",
                ifelse(d97$significant_2fold, "ΔrhlI only",
                       ifelse(d98$significant_2fold, "ΔlasI only", "Not changed")))
  data.frame(media = m, lfc97 = d97$log2FC, lfc98 = d98$log2FC,
             category = cat, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})
scatter <- do.call(rbind, scatter_rows)
scatter$category <- factor(scatter$category,
                           levels = c("Both mutants", "ΔrhlI only",
                                      "ΔlasI only", "Not changed"))
scatter$media_f <- factor(media_short[scatter$media],
                          levels = media_short[levels(meta$Media)])

cor_labels <- overlap %>%
  mutate(media_f = factor(media_short[media],
                          levels = media_short[levels(meta$Media)]),
         label = paste0("r = ", round(lfc_cor_all, 2)))

pC <- ggplot(scatter, aes(lfc97, lfc98)) +
  geom_point(data = subset(scatter, category == "Not changed"),
             colour = "grey75", size = 0.55, alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_point(data = subset(scatter, category != "Not changed"),
             aes(colour = category), size = 0.9, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
              colour = "grey35") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
  geom_text(data = cor_labels, aes(x = -9.3, y = 9, label = label),
            hjust = 0, size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ media_f, nrow = 1) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(-10, 10), ylim = c(-10, 10)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Both mutants" = "#6a3d9a",
                                 "ΔrhlI only" = "#e08214",
                                 "ΔlasI only" = "#3288bd",
                                 "Not changed" = "grey75"),
                      name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "log2 fold change, ΔrhlI (97) vs wild type",
       y = "log2 fold change, ΔlasI (98) vs wild type") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# D. heatmap of the strongest genes across all samples
top_n <- 6
top_loci <- unique(unlist(lapply(res_list, function(d) {
  s <- d[d$significant_2fold, ]
  head(s$locus_tag[order(s$padj)], top_n)
})))

vsd <- vst(dds, blind = TRUE, fitType = "local")
z <- t(scale(t(assay(vsd)[top_loci, ])))
z[is.na(z)] <- 0

sample_order <- order(meta$Media, meta$Strain, meta$Replicate)
sample_ids <- rownames(meta)[sample_order]
z <- z[, sample_ids]

zdf <- data.frame(
  gene   = rep(rownames(z), times = ncol(z)),
  sample = rep(colnames(z), each = nrow(z)),
  z      = as.vector(z),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
zdf <- merge(zdf, meta[, c("AzentaName", "Media", "Strain", "Replicate")],
             by.x = "sample", by.y = "AzentaName")
zdf$sample_label <- paste(zdf$Strain, zdf$Replicate, sep = " ")
zdf$sample_label <- factor(zdf$sample_label,
                           levels = unique(zdf$sample_label[order(
                             zdf$Media, zdf$Strain, zdf$Replicate)]))
zdf$media_f <- factor(media_short[zdf$Media],
                      levels = media_short[levels(meta$Media)])

gene_order <- rownames(z)[hclust(dist(z), method = "ward.D2")$order]
zdf$gene <- factor(zdf$gene, levels = gene_order)

gene_label <- ifelse(annot[gene_order, "gene"] == "", gene_order,
                     annot[gene_order, "gene"])
dup <- duplicated(gene_label) | duplicated(gene_label, fromLast = TRUE)
gene_label[dup] <- paste0(gene_label[dup], " (", gene_order[dup], ")")
names(gene_label) <- gene_order

pD <- ggplot(zdf, aes(sample_label, gene, fill = z)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_grid(~ media_f, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#b2182b",
                       limits = c(-2.5, 2.5), oob = squish,
                       name = "z-score") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = gene_label) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5,
                                   size = 7),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey94", colour = NA),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.key.height = unit(0.9, "cm"))

fig <- (pA | pB) / pC / pD +
  plot_layout(widths = c(3, 2), heights = c(1.1, 1, 1.75)) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A",
    caption = paste(
      "A: genes with FDR < 0.05 and |log2FC| ≥ 1 against wild type in the same medium.",
      "B: overlap of the genes changed in ΔrhlI (97) and ΔlasI (98).",
      "C: all genes; dashed line is y = x, r is the Pearson correlation across all genes.",
      "D: top six genes by adjusted p-value per contrast, VST z-scores."
    ),
    theme = theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
                  plot.caption = element_text(size = 7.5, colour = "grey35",
                                              hjust = 0))
  )

ggsave("results/rnaseq_differential_expression.png", fig,
       width = 14, height = 15, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

cat("\nWrote results/rnaseq_differential_expression.csv\n")
cat("Wrote results/rnaseq_de_summary.csv\n")
cat("Wrote results/rnaseq_mutant_overlap.csv\n")
cat("Wrote results/rnaseq_sensitivity.csv\n")
cat("Wrote results/rnaseq_top_genes.csv\n")
cat("Wrote results/rnaseq_differential_expression.png\n")

value.content:
# One-page summary figure for the PA14 quorum-sensing project.
#
# Reads the result tables already in results/ and draws one panel per project
# question. No models are refitted here: the co-culture curve is redrawn from
# the published quadratic estimates (peak, fitted area at 1:3 and at 100:1) in
# results/swarming_cocultures_ratio_model.csv.
#
# Run from the project root:  Rscript analysis/summary_figure.R

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
  library(tidyr)
  library(dplyr)
})

single <- read.csv("results/swarming_single_mutants_summary.csv",
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
coc <- read.csv("results/swarming_cocultures_summary.csv",
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
model <- read.csv("results/swarming_cocultures_ratio_model.csv",
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rna <- read.csv("results/rnaseq_de_summary.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

get_model <- function(metric, quantity) {
  model$estimate[model$metric == metric & model$quantity == quantity]
}

## ---- panel A: single mutants vs wild type --------------------------------

single$genotype <- factor(single$genotype,
                          levels = c("Wildtype", "ΔlasI", "ΔlasR",
                                     "ΔrhlI", "rhlR-"))
single$genotype_label <- factor(
  ifelse(single$genotype == "Wildtype", "Wild type",
         as.character(single$genotype)),
  levels = c("Wild type", "ΔlasI", "ΔlasR", "ΔrhlI", "rhlR-"))
single$system <- factor(single$system, levels = c("WT", "las", "rhl"))
wt_area <- single$area_geomean[single$genotype == "Wildtype"]

fmt_ratio <- function(x) {
  ifelse(x < 0.1, sprintf("%.3f", x), sprintf("%.2f", x + 1e-9))
}
single$ratio_label <- ifelse(
  single$genotype == "Wildtype", "",
  paste0(fmt_ratio(single$area_ratio_vs_wt), "×\n(",
         fmt_ratio(single$area_ratio_ci_low), "–",
         fmt_ratio(single$area_ratio_ci_high), ")")
)

pA <- ggplot(single, aes(genotype_label, area_geomean, fill = system)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = wt_area, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey35") +
  geom_text(data = subset(single, genotype != "Wildtype"),
            aes(label = ratio_label), vjust = -0.2, size = 2.9,
            lineheight = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(WT = "grey55", las = "#3288bd",
                               rhl = "#e08214"), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma(),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))) +
  labs(title = "Single mutants vs wild type",
       subtitle = "Colony area; labels: ratio vs wild type (95% CI)",
       x = NULL, y = "Colony area (imaging units)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9.5) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, colour = "grey30"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8.5),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

## ---- panel B: co-culture ratio response ----------------------------------

mix <- coc %>%
  filter(culture == "ΔrhlI:ΔlasI", ratio_numeric != "") %>%
  mutate(ratio = as.numeric(ratio_numeric),
         x = log2(ratio),
         in_window = ratio <= 100)

peak_ratio <- get_model("area", "peak_ratio")
peak_area <- get_model("area", "peak_area")
peak_over_wt <- get_model("area", "peak_over_wildtype")
fit_1_3 <- get_model("area", "fitted_area_1to3")
fit_100_1 <- get_model("area", "fitted_area_100to1")
wt_area_coc <- get_model("area", "wildtype_area_geomean")
alone_rhl <- coc$area_geomean[coc$culture == "ΔrhlI"]
alone_las <- coc$area_geomean[coc$culture == "ΔlasI"]

# The reported quadratic in log2(ratio), anchored at its reported peak.
x0 <- log2(peak_ratio)
y0 <- log(peak_area)
x1 <- log2(1 / 3)
y1 <- log(fit_1_3)
c2 <- (y1 - y0) / (x1 - x0)^2
b2 <- -2 * c2 * x0
a2 <- y0 + c2 * x0^2

curve <- data.frame(x = seq(log2(1 / 3), log2(100), length.out = 200))
curve$y <- exp(a2 + b2 * curve$x + c2 * curve$x^2)

pB <- ggplot(mix, aes(x, area_geomean)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
           ymin = alone_rhl, ymax = alone_las,
           fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.18) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = wt_area_coc, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "grey35") +
  annotate("text", x = 9.8, y = wt_area_coc * 1.06,
           label = "wild type", hjust = 1, size = 2.8, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_line(data = curve, aes(x, y), colour = "#6a3d9a", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = in_window), size = 2, colour = "black") +
  annotate("segment", x = x0, xend = x0, y = 0, yend = peak_area,
           linetype = "dotted", colour = "#6a3d9a") +
  annotate("point", x = x0, y = peak_area, shape = 21, size = 4,
           stroke = 1.1, colour = "#6a3d9a", fill = "white") +
  annotate("text", x = x0 + 0.15, y = peak_area * 1.18,
           label = paste0("peak ", sprintf("%.1f", peak_ratio), ":1\n",
                          comma(peak_area), " (",
                          sprintf("%.2f", peak_over_wt), "× wild type)"),
           hjust = 0, size = 2.9, colour = "#4a2a6a") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 16, `FALSE` = 1),
                     breaks = c(TRUE, FALSE),
                     labels = c("In fit window", "Outside fit"),
                     name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = log2(c(1 / 3, 1 / 2, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 50, 100, 500, 1000)),
    labels = c("1:3", "", "1:1", "", "3:1", "", "", "10:1", "",
               "100:1", "", "1000:1")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma(), limits = c(0, 210000),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  labs(title = "Co-culture rescue",
       subtitle = "Geometric mean of three dishes at each mix ratio; curve: reported fit",
       x = "ΔrhlI : ΔlasI ratio (log scale)",
       y = "Colony area (imaging units)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9.5) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, colour = "grey30"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

## ---- panel C: genes changed per mutant and medium ------------------------

mutant_lab <- c("ΔrhlI" = "ΔrhlI\n(97)",
                "ΔlasI" = "ΔlasI\n(98)",
                "ΔlasIΔrhlI" = "ΔlasIΔrhlI\n(99)")
media_lab <- c("MMGluFeMinus" = "MMGlu Fe−",
               "MMGluFePlus" = "MMGlu Fe+",
               "Succinate" = "Succinate")

rna$mutant <- factor(rna$mutant,
                     levels = c("ΔrhlI", "ΔlasI", "ΔlasIΔrhlI"))
rna$media <- factor(rna$media,
                    levels = c("MMGluFeMinus", "MMGluFePlus", "Succinate"))
rna$mutant_f <- factor(mutant_lab[as.character(rna$mutant)],
                       levels = mutant_lab[c("ΔrhlI", "ΔlasI", "ΔlasIΔrhlI")])
rna$media_f <- factor(media_lab[as.character(rna$media)],
                      levels = media_lab[c("MMGluFeMinus", "MMGluFePlus",
                                           "Succinate")])

rna_long <- rna %>%
  select(media_f, mutant_f, up, down) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(up, down), names_to = "direction", values_to = "n")
rna_long$direction <- factor(rna_long$direction,
                             levels = c("up", "down"),
                             labels = c("Up", "Down"))

pC <- ggplot(rna_long, aes(mutant_f, n, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(data = rna,
            aes(x = mutant_f, y = DE_FDR05_2fold,
                label = DE_FDR05_2fold),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ media_f, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Up = "#c0392b", Down = "#2c6fbb"),
                    name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma(),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))) +
  labs(title = "Transcriptome changes",
       subtitle = "Genes changed (FDR < 0.05, |log2FC| ≥ 1); 5,828 genes tested",
       x = NULL, y = "Genes changed") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9.5) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, colour = "grey30"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

## ---- one page -------------------------------------------------------------

caption_paragraphs <- c(
  "A: bars are geometric means of three dishes; labels are ratios vs wild type (95% CI); dashed line is the wild-type geometric mean (81,732); pooled rhl vs las mutants: 0.50× (95% CI 0.35–0.71, p = 0.0015).",
  "B: points are geometric means of three dishes at each mix ratio; the curve is the reported quadratic fit over 1:3–100:1; the large open circle is the fitted peak (12.3:1, 145,880, 1.34× wild type); the dashed line is wild type (108,686); the grey band spans the two single mutants alone (10,263 and 14,522); open points at 500:1 and 1000:1 are outside the fitted window.",
  "C: genes with FDR < 0.05 and |log2FC| ≥ 1; media are MMGluFeMinus, MMGluFePlus and Succinate. Colony area is in imaging-software units and is compared only within this assay."
)
caption_text <- paste(
  unlist(lapply(caption_paragraphs, function(x) strwrap(x, width = 155))),
  collapse = "\n"
)

fig <- (pA | pB) / pC +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.05)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "PA14 quorum sensing and swarming: summary of the three questions",
    subtitle = "A: single mutants vs wild type.  B: co-culture rescue.  C: transcriptome changes.",
    tag_levels = "A",
    caption = caption_text,
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey30"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 7.4, colour = "grey35", hjust = 0),
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
    )
  )

ggsave("results/summary.png", fig, width = 13, height = 10,
       dpi = 300, bg = "white")
cat("Wrote results/summary.png\n")

value.content:
# PA14 quorum sensing and swarming: conclusions

**One-page figure:** [summary.png](summary.png)

Three questions, each answered briefly below with its key numbers and figure. The full analyses and result files are in the project.

## 1. Do the single quorum-sensing mutants swarm worse than wild type?

Yes. All four single mutants swarmed far less than wild type, and the rhl mutants were the more severe loss. Mutant colonies were also much more circular while roundness was unchanged, so the shape change is in perimeter irregularity rather than elongation.

| Mutant | Colony area ratio vs wild type (95% CI) |
|---|---:|
| ΔlasI | 0.27 (0.13–0.57) |
| ΔlasR | 0.29 (0.16–0.50) |
| ΔrhlI | 0.15 (0.063–0.34) |
| rhlR- | 0.13 (0.091–0.19) |

- Wild-type geometric mean area: 81,732; every mutant comparison had Holm-adjusted p ≤ 0.016.
- Pooled rhl mutants vs pooled las mutants: area ratio 0.50 (95% CI 0.35–0.71, p = 0.0015).
- Circularity rose from 0.076 in wild type to 0.40–0.62 in the mutants (5.2–8.2×); roundness did not change consistently (Holm p ≥ 0.41).

![Colony area, circularity and roundness of wild type and the four single mutants](swarming_single_mutants.png)

Details: [swarming_single_mutants_summary.csv](swarming_single_mutants_summary.csv), [swarming_system_contrast.csv](swarming_system_contrast.csv).

## 2. Does mixing ΔrhlI and ΔlasI restore swarming, and at which ratio?

Yes, and the rescue has a clear optimum. The fitted peak was at 12.3:1 ΔrhlI:ΔlasI, where colony area was 1.34× wild type and roughly 14× and 10× the two mutants grown alone. The ratio explained most of the variation in area, and the peak was statistically indistinguishable from wild type; at 500:1 the rescue collapsed.

- Peak: 12.3:1 ΔrhlI:ΔlasI (95% CI 10.4–14.7); peak area 145,880 (132,127–161,011), 1.34× wild type (95% CI 0.99–1.71).
- The 10:1 mix was 1.64× wild type (0.83–3.25; Holm-adjusted p = 0.90); 500:1 was 0.09× wild type (0.05–0.18; Holm p = 0.037).
- Ratio explained 93% of the variance in log area across the ten well-sampled ratios (1:3–100:1; one-way ANOVA F(9,20) = 29.5, p = 1.2e-9); the quadratic fit had R² = 0.891 versus 0.364 for a linear fit.
- Fitted area reached wild-type level between 3.2:1 and 46.4:1; the peak was 8.7× the 1:3 value and 2.1× the 100:1 value.

![Colony area, circularity and roundness across ΔrhlI:ΔlasI mix ratios](swarming_cocultures.png)

Details: [swarming_cocultures_summary.csv](swarming_cocultures_summary.csv), [swarming_cocultures_ratio_model.csv](swarming_cocultures_ratio_model.csv).

## 3. What do the mutants change in gene expression?

Each mutant changes a large, medium-specific part of the transcriptome. The strongest signals were the quorum-sensing genes themselves, phenazine biosynthesis, denitrification and oxidative-stress genes. The two single mutants shared a significant but medium-dependent set of changes, mostly in the same direction, and the double mutant behaved largely additively.

Genes changed (FDR < 0.05 and |log2FC| ≥ 1), by medium:

| Mutant | MMGluFeMinus | MMGluFePlus | Succinate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| ΔrhlI (97) | 389 | 533 | 416 |
| ΔlasI (98) | 384 | 461 | 1,087 |
| ΔlasIΔrhlI (99) | 1,362 | 1,345 | 1,166 |

- Nine contrasts, 5,828 genes tested. Counting FDR alone instead of the two-fold threshold gives 1,299–3,585 genes per contrast.
- Single-mutant overlap: 78 / 214 / 315 shared genes in MMGluFeMinus / MMGluFePlus / Succinate (Jaccard 0.112 / 0.274 / 0.265; hypergeometric p 2.1e-20 / 1.4e-112 / 1.5e-156).
- Direction agreement among shared genes: 79% / 98% / 99%; genome-wide log2 fold-change correlation 0.30 / 0.53 / 0.66.
- Double mutant: 793 / 674 / 213 genes changed in neither single; its log2FC regressed on the sum of the single effects with slopes 1.04 / 0.84 / 0.71 (R² 0.73 / 0.73 / 0.90).

![Genes changed per mutant and medium, overlap of the single mutants, fold-change agreement and a heatmap of the strongest genes](rnaseq_differential_expression.png)

Details: [rnaseq_de_summary.csv](rnaseq_de_summary.csv), [rnaseq_mutant_overlap.csv](rnaseq_mutant_overlap.csv), [rnaseq_differential_expression.csv](rnaseq_differential_expression.csv), [rnaseq_top_genes.csv](rnaseq_top_genes.csv).

value.content:
# Swarming rescue in PA14 ΔrhlI + ΔlasI co-cultures
#
# Reads data/swarming/cocultures.csv and writes
#   results/swarming_cocultures_summary.csv      one row per condition: descriptive
#     statistics and, for each mix ratio, the comparison against wild type
#   results/swarming_cocultures_ratio_model.csv  model fit, peak location, ratio
#     effect size and sensitivity analyses
#   results/swarming_cocultures.png              three-panel figure
#
# Run from the project root:  Rscript analysis/swarming_cocultures.R
#
# Colony area and circularity are analysed on the log scale, so differences are
# ratios of geometric means; roundness is analysed on its raw scale. Each mix
# ratio is compared with wild type by Welch t-test, with Holm adjustment across
# the twelve mix ratios within each metric.
#
# The ratio response is modelled as a quadratic in log2(ratio) over the rescue
# window 1:3-100:1. The two extreme ratios (500:1 and 1000:1) are outside the
# fitted window: at 500:1 rescue failed in all three dishes, and 1000:1 was
# heterogeneous (one dish failed, two were partially rescued).

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
})

dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)

## ---- data ----------------------------------------------------------------

coc <- read.csv("data/swarming/cocultures.csv", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
coc$culture <- factor(coc$culture,
                      levels = c("wild type", "ΔlasI", "ΔrhlI", "ΔrhlI:ΔlasI"))

ratio_levels <- c("1:3", "1:2", "1:1", "2:1", "3:1", "4:1",
                  "5:1", "10:1", "50:1", "100:1", "500:1", "1000:1")

mix <- subset(coc, culture == "ΔrhlI:ΔlasI")
mix$ratio <- as.numeric(sub(":.*", "", mix$ratio_rhlI_to_lasI)) /
             as.numeric(sub(".*:", "", mix$ratio_rhlI_to_lasI))
mix$ratio_label <- factor(mix$ratio_rhlI_to_lasI, levels = ratio_levels)
mix <- mix[order(mix$ratio), ]

wt_area  <- coc$area[coc$culture == "wild type"]
wt_circ  <- coc$circularity[coc$culture == "wild type"]
wt_round <- coc$roundness[coc$culture == "wild type"]
wt_area_gm <- exp(mean(log(wt_area)))

## ---- comparisons with wild type ------------------------------------------

welch_vs_wt <- function(df, var, tf = identity) {
  wtv <- tf(df[[var]][df$culture == "wild type"])
  out <- df %>%
    filter(culture == "ΔrhlI:ΔlasI") %>%
    group_by(ratio_rhlI_to_lasI) %>%
    group_modify(function(.x, .y) {
      x <- tf(.x[[var]])
      tt <- t.test(x, wtv, var.equal = FALSE)
      data.frame(
        n = nrow(.x),
        estimate = unname(tt$estimate[1] - tt$estimate[2]),
        ci_low   = unname(tt$conf.int[1]),
        ci_high  = unname(tt$conf.int[2]),
        p_raw    = tt$p.value
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    as.data.frame()
  out$ratio_label <- factor(out$ratio_rhlI_to_lasI, levels = ratio_levels)
  out <- out[order(out$ratio_label), ]
  out$p_holm <- p.adjust(out$p_raw, method = "holm")
  out
}

area_t <- welch_vs_wt(coc, "area", log)
area_t$ratio      <- exp(area_t$estimate)
area_t$ratio_low  <- exp(area_t$ci_low)
area_t$ratio_high <- exp(area_t$ci_high)

circ_t <- welch_vs_wt(coc, "circularity", log)
circ_t$ratio      <- exp(circ_t$estimate)
circ_t$ratio_low  <- exp(circ_t$ci_low)
circ_t$ratio_high <- exp(circ_t$ci_high)

round_t <- welch_vs_wt(coc, "roundness", identity)

# Single mutants: descriptive comparison against wild type (context only; the
# tested family is the twelve mix ratios).
single_stats <- function(grp, var, tf = identity) {
  x <- tf(coc[[var]][coc$culture == grp])
  w <- tf(coc[[var]][coc$culture == "wild type"])
  tt <- t.test(x, w, var.equal = FALSE)
  c(est = unname(tt$estimate[1] - tt$estimate[2]),
    lo  = unname(tt$conf.int[1]),
    hi  = unname(tt$conf.int[2]))
}

## ---- descriptive table ---------------------------------------------------

condition_levels <- c("wild type", "ΔlasI", "ΔrhlI", paste0("mix ", ratio_levels))

desc <- coc %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(
    ifelse(culture == "ΔrhlI:ΔlasI",
           paste0("mix ", ratio_rhlI_to_lasI),
           as.character(culture)),
    levels = condition_levels)) %>%
  group_by(condition, culture, ratio_rhlI_to_lasI) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    area_mean = mean(area), area_sd = sd(area),
    area_geomean = exp(mean(log(area))),
    circularity_mean = mean(circularity), circularity_sd = sd(circularity),
    roundness_mean = mean(roundness), roundness_sd = sd(roundness),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

tab <- desc
tab$area_ratio_vs_wt         <- NA_real_
tab$area_ratio_ci_low        <- NA_real_
tab$area_ratio_ci_high       <- NA_real_
tab$area_change_pct          <- NA_real_
tab$area_p_holm              <- NA_real_
tab$circularity_ratio_vs_wt  <- NA_real_
tab$circularity_ratio_ci_low <- NA_real_
tab$circularity_ratio_ci_high <- NA_real_
tab$circularity_p_holm       <- NA_real_
tab$roundness_diff_vs_wt     <- NA_real_
tab$roundness_diff_ci_low    <- NA_real_
tab$roundness_diff_ci_high   <- NA_real_
tab$roundness_p_holm         <- NA_real_

# Wild type is the reference row.
i <- which(tab$condition == "wild type")
tab$area_ratio_vs_wt[i] <- 1
tab$area_ratio_ci_low[i] <- 1
tab$area_ratio_ci_high[i] <- 1
tab$area_change_pct[i] <- 0
tab$circularity_ratio_vs_wt[i] <- 1
tab$circularity_ratio_ci_low[i] <- 1
tab$circularity_ratio_ci_high[i] <- 1
tab$roundness_diff_vs_wt[i] <- 0
tab$roundness_diff_ci_low[i] <- 0
tab$roundness_diff_ci_high[i] <- 0

# Mix ratios: tested against wild type.
mi <- match(as.character(tab$ratio_rhlI_to_lasI), as.character(area_t$ratio_label))
rows <- which(!is.na(mi) & tab$culture == "ΔrhlI:ΔlasI")
tab$area_ratio_vs_wt[rows]         <- area_t$ratio[mi[rows]]
tab$area_ratio_ci_low[rows]        <- area_t$ratio_low[mi[rows]]
tab$area_ratio_ci_high[rows]       <- area_t$ratio_high[mi[rows]]
tab$area_change_pct[rows]          <- (area_t$ratio[mi[rows]] - 1) * 100
tab$area_p_holm[rows]              <- area_t$p_holm[mi[rows]]
tab$circularity_ratio_vs_wt[rows]  <- circ_t$ratio[mi[rows]]
tab$circularity_ratio_ci_low[rows] <- circ_t$ratio_low[mi[rows]]
tab$circularity_ratio_ci_high[rows] <- circ_t$ratio_high[mi[rows]]
tab$circularity_p_holm[rows]       <- circ_t$p_holm[mi[rows]]
tab$roundness_diff_vs_wt[rows]     <- round_t$estimate[mi[rows]]
tab$roundness_diff_ci_low[rows]    <- round_t$ci_low[mi[rows]]
tab$roundness_diff_ci_high[rows]   <- round_t$ci_high[mi[rows]]
tab$roundness_p_holm[rows]         <- round_t$p_holm[mi[rows]]

# Single mutants: descriptive ratios/differences against wild type.
for (g in c("ΔlasI", "ΔrhlI")) {
  i <- which(tab$culture == g)
  sa <- single_stats(g, "area", log)
  tab$area_ratio_vs_wt[i]   <- exp(sa["est"])
  tab$area_ratio_ci_low[i]  <- exp(sa["lo"])
  tab$area_ratio_ci_high[i] <- exp(sa["hi"])
  tab$area_change_pct[i]    <- (exp(sa["est"]) - 1) * 100
  sc <- single_stats(g, "circularity", log)
  tab$circularity_ratio_vs_wt[i]   <- exp(sc["est"])
  tab$circularity_ratio_ci_low[i]  <- exp(sc["lo"])
  tab$circularity_ratio_ci_high[i] <- exp(sc["hi"])
  sr <- single_stats(g, "roundness", identity)
  tab$roundness_diff_vs_wt[i]   <- sr["est"]
  tab$roundness_diff_ci_low[i]  <- sr["lo"]
  tab$roundness_diff_ci_high[i] <- sr["hi"]
}

fmt <- function(x, digits) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits))
}
fmt_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p), "",
         ifelse(p < 0.001, formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 1),
                formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)))
}

ratio_numeric <- ifelse(tab$culture == "ΔrhlI:ΔlasI",
                        as.numeric(sub(":.*", "", tab$ratio_rhlI_to_lasI)) /
                          as.numeric(sub(".*:", "", tab$ratio_rhlI_to_lasI)),
                        NA_real_)

summary_out <- data.frame(
  condition = as.character(tab$condition),
  culture = as.character(tab$culture),
  ratio_rhlI_to_lasI = tab$ratio_rhlI_to_lasI,
  ratio_numeric = ifelse(is.na(ratio_numeric), "", fmt(ratio_numeric, 3)),
  n = tab$n,
  area_mean = fmt(tab$area_mean, 0),
  area_sd = fmt(tab$area_sd, 0),
  area_geomean = fmt(tab$area_geomean, 0),
  area_ratio_vs_wt = fmt(tab$area_ratio_vs_wt, 3),
  area_ratio_ci_low = fmt(tab$area_ratio_ci_low, 3),
  area_ratio_ci_high = fmt(tab$area_ratio_ci_high, 3),
  area_change_pct = fmt(tab$area_change_pct, 1),
  area_p_holm = fmt_p(tab$area_p_holm),
  circularity_mean = fmt(tab$circularity_mean, 3),
  circularity_sd = fmt(tab$circularity_sd, 3),
  circularity_ratio_vs_wt = fmt(tab$circularity_ratio_vs_wt, 2),
  circularity_ratio_ci_low = fmt(tab$circularity_ratio_ci_low, 2),
  circularity_ratio_ci_high = fmt(tab$circularity_ratio_ci_high, 2),
  circularity_p_holm = fmt_p(tab$circularity_p_holm),
  roundness_mean = fmt(tab$roundness_mean, 3),
  roundness_sd = fmt(tab$roundness_sd, 3),
  roundness_diff_vs_wt = fmt(tab$roundness_diff_vs_wt, 3),
  roundness_diff_ci_low = fmt(tab$roundness_diff_ci_low, 3),
  roundness_diff_ci_high = fmt(tab$roundness_diff_ci_high, 3),
  roundness_p_holm = fmt_p(tab$roundness_p_holm)
)

write.csv(summary_out, "results/swarming_cocultures_summary.csv",
          row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

## ---- ratio model ---------------------------------------------------------

win <- subset(mix, ratio >= 1/3 & ratio <= 100)
win$x <- log2(win$ratio)

m_lin  <- lm(log(area) ~ x, data = win)
m_quad <- lm(log(area) ~ x + I(x^2), data = win)
m_cub  <- lm(log(area) ~ x + I(x^2) + I(x^3), data = win)

cf <- coef(m_quad)
peak_log2  <- -cf[2] / (2 * cf[3])
peak_ratio <- 2^peak_log2
peak_area  <- exp(cf[1] - cf[2]^2 / (4 * cf[3]))

# Cluster bootstrap: resample the three dishes within each ratio.
set.seed(1)
boot <- t(replicate(5000, {
  idx <- unlist(lapply(split(seq_len(nrow(win)), win$ratio),
                       function(i) sample(i, length(i), replace = TRUE)))
  bcf <- coef(lm(log(area) ~ x + I(x^2), data = win[idx, ]))
  if (is.na(bcf[3]) || bcf[3] >= 0) {
    c(NA_real_, NA_real_)
  } else {
    c(2^(-bcf[2] / (2 * bcf[3])),
      exp(bcf[1] - bcf[2]^2 / (4 * bcf[3])))
  }
}))
boot_peak <- boot[, 1]
boot_val  <- boot[, 2]
peak_ci      <- quantile(boot_peak, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
peak_val_ci  <- quantile(boot_val,  c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

# The peak-to-wild-type ratio also carries wild-type dish variability, so
# resample the three wild-type dishes as well as the mix dishes.
set.seed(1)
boot_wt <- replicate(5000, {
  idx <- unlist(lapply(split(seq_len(nrow(win)), win$ratio),
                       function(i) sample(i, length(i), replace = TRUE)))
  bcf <- coef(lm(log(area) ~ x + I(x^2), data = win[idx, ]))
  if (is.na(bcf[3]) || bcf[3] >= 0) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    exp(bcf[1] - bcf[2]^2 / (4 * bcf[3])) /
      exp(mean(log(sample(wt_area, 3, replace = TRUE))))
  }
})
peak_wt_ci <- quantile(boot_wt, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

# Fitted values at the ends of the window and at the peak.
fit_area <- function(r) exp(predict(m_quad, newdata = data.frame(x = log2(r))))
fit_1to3  <- fit_area(1/3)
fit_100to1 <- fit_area(100)
obs_500_gm <- exp(mean(log(mix$area[mix$ratio == 500])))

# Ratios where the fitted area reaches the wild-type geometric mean.
roots <- polyroot(c(cf[1] - log(wt_area_gm), cf[2], cf[3]))
roots <- Re(roots[abs(Im(roots)) < 1e-8])
wt_low  <- min(2^roots)
wt_high <- max(2^roots)

# One-way ratio effect among the mix conditions.
one_way_r2 <- function(d, var, tf) {
  y <- tf(d[[var]])
  a <- aov(y ~ factor(ratio), data = d)
  s <- summary(a)[[1]][["Sum Sq"]]
  s[1] / sum(s)
}
one_way_p <- function(d, var, tf) {
  y <- tf(d[[var]])
  a <- aov(y ~ factor(ratio), data = d)
  summary(a)[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1]
}

# Sensitivity fits.
fit_peak_r2 <- function(d) {
  d$x <- log2(d$ratio)
  m <- lm(log(area) ~ x + I(x^2), data = d)
  cf <- coef(m)
  c(peak = unname(2^(-cf[2] / (2 * cf[3]))),
    r2 = unname(summary(m)$r.squared))
}
sens_all      <- fit_peak_r2(mix)
sens_excl1000 <- fit_peak_r2(subset(mix, ratio != 1000))
sens_excl500  <- fit_peak_r2(subset(mix, ratio != 500))

# Leave-one-ratio-out peak estimates.
loo <- sapply(sort(unique(win$ratio)), function(r) {
  d <- subset(win, ratio != r)
  cf <- coef(lm(log(area) ~ x + I(x^2), data = d))
  2^(-cf[2] / (2 * cf[3]))
})

# Model assumptions.
levene_p  <- car::leveneTest(log(area) ~ factor(ratio), data = win)$`Pr(>F)`[1]
shapiro_p <- shapiro.test(resid(m_quad))$p.value
max_cook  <- max(cooks.distance(m_quad))

# Circularity and roundness on the same window.
m_circ_lin <- lm(log(circularity) ~ x, data = win)
m_circ     <- lm(log(circularity) ~ x + I(x^2), data = win)
ccf <- coef(m_circ)
circ_min_x     <- -ccf[2] / (2 * ccf[3])
circ_min_ratio <- 2^circ_min_x
circ_min       <- exp(ccf[1] - ccf[2]^2 / (4 * ccf[3]))

m_round_lin <- lm(roundness ~ x, data = win)
m_round     <- lm(roundness ~ x + I(x^2), data = win)
rcf <- coef(m_round)
round_max_x     <- -rcf[2] / (2 * rcf[3])
round_max_ratio <- 2^round_max_x
round_max       <- rcf[1] - rcf[2]^2 / (4 * rcf[3])

fit_circ <- function(r) exp(predict(m_circ, newdata = data.frame(x = log2(r))))
fit_round <- function(r) predict(m_round, newdata = data.frame(x = log2(r)))

## ---- model table ---------------------------------------------------------

mrow <- function(metric, quantity, estimate, ci_low = NA, ci_high = NA, detail = "") {
  data.frame(metric = metric, quantity = quantity,
             estimate = unname(estimate), ci_low = unname(ci_low),
             ci_high = unname(ci_high), detail = detail,
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

model_out <- rbind(
  mrow("area", "model", NA,
       detail = "quadratic in log2(ratio), ratios 1:3-100:1, 30 dishes, 10 ratios"),
  mrow("area", "quadratic_r2", summary(m_quad)$r.squared,
       detail = "fraction of log-area variance explained"),
  mrow("area", "linear_r2", summary(m_lin)$r.squared,
       detail = "linear fit in log2(ratio) for comparison"),
  mrow("area", "quadratic_term_p", anova(m_lin, m_quad)$`Pr(>F)`[2],
       detail = "test of adding the quadratic term"),
  mrow("area", "cubic_term_p", anova(m_quad, m_cub)$`Pr(>F)`[2],
       detail = "test of adding a cubic term"),
  mrow("area", "residual_sd_log", summary(m_quad)$sigma,
       detail = "residual standard deviation on the log scale"),
  mrow("area", "ratio_one_way_r2", one_way_r2(win, "area", log),
       detail = "one-way ANOVA across the 10 window ratios"),
  mrow("area", "ratio_one_way_p", one_way_p(win, "area", log),
       detail = "one-way ANOVA F test across the 10 window ratios"),
  mrow("area", "peak_ratio", peak_ratio, peak_ci[1], peak_ci[2],
       detail = "fitted peak; cluster bootstrap 95% CI, 5000 resamples"),
  mrow("area", "peak_area", peak_area, peak_val_ci[1], peak_val_ci[2],
       detail = "fitted geometric mean at the peak; bootstrap 95% CI"),
  mrow("area", "peak_over_wildtype", peak_area / wt_area_gm,
       peak_wt_ci[1], peak_wt_ci[2],
       detail = "fitted peak geometric mean / wild-type geometric mean; bootstrap 95% CI resampling mix and wild-type dishes"),
  mrow("area", "fold_peak_vs_1to3", peak_area / fit_1to3,
       detail = "fitted peak / fitted value at 1:3"),
  mrow("area", "fold_peak_vs_100to1", peak_area / fit_100to1,
       detail = "fitted peak / fitted value at 100:1"),
  mrow("area", "fold_peak_vs_500to1", peak_area / obs_500_gm,
       detail = "fitted peak / observed 500:1 geometric mean"),
  mrow("area", "fitted_area_1to3", fit_1to3, detail = "fitted geometric mean"),
  mrow("area", "fitted_area_100to1", fit_100to1, detail = "fitted geometric mean"),
  mrow("area", "wildtype_area_geomean", wt_area_gm,
       detail = "geometric mean of the three wild-type dishes"),
  mrow("area", "wt_level_ratio_low", wt_low,
       detail = "lower mix ratio where the fitted area reaches the wild-type mean"),
  mrow("area", "wt_level_ratio_high", wt_high,
       detail = "upper mix ratio where the fitted area reaches the wild-type mean"),
  mrow("area", "peak_ratio_all12", sens_all["peak"],
       detail = "sensitivity: all 12 ratios included"),
  mrow("area", "quadratic_r2_all12", sens_all["r2"],
       detail = "sensitivity: all 12 ratios included"),
  mrow("area", "peak_ratio_excl1000", sens_excl1000["peak"],
       detail = "sensitivity: 1000:1 excluded"),
  mrow("area", "quadratic_r2_excl1000", sens_excl1000["r2"],
       detail = "sensitivity: 1000:1 excluded"),
  mrow("area", "peak_ratio_excl500", sens_excl500["peak"],
       detail = "sensitivity: 500:1 excluded"),
  mrow("area", "quadratic_r2_excl500", sens_excl500["r2"],
       detail = "sensitivity: 500:1 excluded"),
  mrow("area", "loo_peak_min", min(loo),
       detail = "minimum peak estimate leaving one ratio out"),
  mrow("area", "loo_peak_max", max(loo),
       detail = "maximum peak estimate leaving one ratio out"),
  mrow("area", "levene_p", levene_p,
       detail = "Levene test on log area across the 10 window ratios"),
  mrow("area", "shapiro_p", shapiro_p,
       detail = "Shapiro-Wilk test of the quadratic residuals"),
  mrow("area", "max_cooks_d", max_cook,
       detail = "largest Cook's distance in the quadratic fit"),
  mrow("circularity", "model", NA,
       detail = "quadratic in log2(ratio) on log circularity, ratios 1:3-100:1"),
  mrow("circularity", "quadratic_r2", summary(m_circ)$r.squared,
       detail = "fraction of log-circularity variance explained"),
  mrow("circularity", "linear_r2", summary(m_circ_lin)$r.squared,
       detail = "linear fit for comparison"),
  mrow("circularity", "quadratic_term_p", anova(m_circ_lin, m_circ)$`Pr(>F)`[2],
       detail = "test of adding the quadratic term"),
  mrow("circularity", "minimum_ratio", circ_min_ratio,
       detail = "ratio of the fitted circularity minimum"),
  mrow("circularity", "fitted_min_circularity", circ_min,
       detail = "fitted circularity at the minimum"),
  mrow("circularity", "wildtype_circularity_mean", mean(wt_circ),
       detail = "mean of the three wild-type dishes"),
  mrow("circularity", "min_over_wildtype", circ_min / mean(wt_circ),
       detail = "fitted minimum / wild-type mean"),
  mrow("circularity", "fitted_circularity_1to3", fit_circ(1/3),
       detail = "fitted value at 1:3"),
  mrow("circularity", "fitted_circularity_100to1", fit_circ(100),
       detail = "fitted value at 100:1"),
  mrow("roundness", "model", NA,
       detail = "quadratic in log2(ratio), ratios 1:3-100:1; secondary readout"),
  mrow("roundness", "quadratic_r2", summary(m_round)$r.squared,
       detail = "fraction of roundness variance explained"),
  mrow("roundness", "linear_r2", summary(m_round_lin)$r.squared,
       detail = "linear fit for comparison"),
  mrow("roundness", "quadratic_term_p", anova(m_round_lin, m_round)$`Pr(>F)`[2],
       detail = "test of adding the quadratic term"),
  mrow("roundness", "ratio_one_way_r2", one_way_r2(win, "roundness", identity),
       detail = "one-way ANOVA across the 10 window ratios"),
  mrow("roundness", "fitted_max_ratio", round_max_ratio,
       detail = "ratio of the fitted roundness maximum"),
  mrow("roundness", "fitted_max_roundness", round_max,
       detail = "fitted roundness at the maximum"),
  mrow("roundness", "wildtype_roundness_mean", mean(wt_round),
       detail = "mean of the three wild-type dishes"),
  mrow("roundness", "fitted_roundness_1to3", fit_round(1/3),
       detail = "fitted value at 1:3"),
  mrow("roundness", "fitted_roundness_100to1", fit_round(100),
       detail = "fitted value at 100:1")
)

model_out[c("estimate", "ci_low", "ci_high")] <-
  lapply(model_out[c("estimate", "ci_low", "ci_high")], function(x) signif(x, 6))

write.csv(model_out, "results/swarming_cocultures_ratio_model.csv",
          row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

## ---- console checks ------------------------------------------------------

cat("Welch comparisons of each mix ratio with wild type\n")
print(area_t[, c("ratio_label", "n", "ratio", "ratio_low", "ratio_high",
                 "p_raw", "p_holm")], row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)

cat("\nQuadratic area model, window 1:3-100:1\n")
print(summary(m_quad))
cat("Peak ratio:", round(peak_ratio, 2), ":1  95% CI",
    paste(round(peak_ci, 2), collapse = "-"), "\n")

    round(circ_min, 3), "vs wild type", round(mean(wt_circ), 3), "\n")
cat("Roundness fitted maximum at", round(round_max_ratio, 2), ":1; fitted",

cat("\nAssumption checks: Levene p =", signif(levene_p, 3),
    "; Shapiro p =", signif(shapiro_p, 3),

## ---- figure --------------------------------------------------------------

series_levels <- c("ΔrhlI:ΔlasI mix", "Wild type", "ΔlasI alone", "ΔrhlI alone")
series_cols <- c("ΔrhlI:ΔlasI mix" = "#6250d6", "Wild type" = "#52514e",

ref <- data.frame(

pred_grid <- data.frame(x = seq(log2(1/3), log2(100), length.out = 200))

theme_swarm <- theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +

x_scale <- scale_x_log10(

p_area <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = pred_area, aes(x = ratio, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),

           label = "peak 12:1 (95% CI 10–15:1)", hjust = 0,

  scale_y_log10(

  geom_ribbon(data = pred_circ, aes(x = ratio, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),

             aes(yintercept = circularity, colour = series),

value.content:
# Swarming of PA14 single quorum-sensing mutants vs wild type
#
# Reads data/swarming/single_cultures.csv and writes
#   results/swarming_single_mutants_summary.csv  one row per genotype: descriptive
#     statistics and each mutant's comparison against wild type
#   results/swarming_system_contrast.csv         rhl mutants vs las mutants
#   results/swarming_single_mutants.png          three-panel figure
#
# Run from the project root:  Rscript analysis/swarming_single_mutants.R
#
# Colony area and circularity are analysed on the log scale, so a difference in
# means there is a ratio of geometric means; roundness is analysed on its raw
# scale. Each mutant is compared with wild type by Welch t-test (unequal
# variances), with Holm adjustment across the four mutants within each metric.

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
})

dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)

sw <- read.csv("data/swarming/single_cultures.csv", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
sw$genotype <- factor(sw$genotype,
                      levels = c("Wildtype", "ΔlasI", "ΔlasR", "ΔrhlI", "rhlR-"))
sw$system <- factor(
  ifelse(sw$genotype == "Wildtype", "WT",
         ifelse(sw$genotype %in% c("ΔlasI", "ΔlasR"), "las", "rhl")),
  levels = c("WT", "las", "rhl")
)

## ---- comparisons against wild type ---------------------------------------

welch_vs_wt <- function(df, var, transform = identity) {
  wt <- transform(df[[var]][df$genotype == "Wildtype"])
  muts <- setdiff(levels(df$genotype), "Wildtype")
  out <- lapply(muts, function(g) {
    x <- transform(df[[var]][df$genotype == g])
    tt <- t.test(x, wt, var.equal = FALSE)
    data.frame(
      genotype = g,
      estimate = unname(tt$estimate[1] - tt$estimate[2]),
      ci_low   = unname(tt$conf.int[1]),
      ci_high  = unname(tt$conf.int[2]),
      df       = unname(tt$parameter),
      p_raw    = tt$p.value
    )
  })
  out <- do.call(rbind, out)
  out$p_holm <- p.adjust(out$p_raw, method = "holm")
  out
}

area_t <- welch_vs_wt(sw, "area", log)
area_t$ratio      <- exp(area_t$estimate)
area_t$ratio_low  <- exp(area_t$ci_low)
area_t$ratio_high <- exp(area_t$ci_high)

circ_t <- welch_vs_wt(sw, "circularity", log)
circ_t$ratio      <- exp(circ_t$estimate)
circ_t$ratio_low  <- exp(circ_t$ci_low)
circ_t$ratio_high <- exp(circ_t$ci_high)

round_t <- welch_vs_wt(sw, "roundness")

## ---- descriptive statistics and main table -------------------------------

desc <- sw %>%
  group_by(genotype, system) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    area_mean = mean(area), area_sd = sd(area),
    area_geomean = exp(mean(log(area))),
    circularity_mean = mean(circularity), circularity_sd = sd(circularity),
    roundness_mean = mean(roundness), roundness_sd = sd(roundness),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

tab <- desc
take <- function(t, col) t[[col]][match(tab$genotype, t$genotype)]

tab$area_ratio_vs_wt     <- take(area_t, "ratio")
tab$area_ratio_ci_low    <- take(area_t, "ratio_low")
tab$area_ratio_ci_high   <- take(area_t, "ratio_high")
tab$area_change_pct      <- (tab$area_ratio_vs_wt - 1) * 100
tab$area_p_holm          <- take(area_t, "p_holm")
tab$circularity_ratio_vs_wt   <- take(circ_t, "ratio")
tab$circularity_ratio_ci_low  <- take(circ_t, "ratio_low")
tab$circularity_ratio_ci_high <- take(circ_t, "ratio_high")
tab$circularity_p_holm        <- take(circ_t, "p_holm")
tab$roundness_diff_vs_wt      <- take(round_t, "estimate")
tab$roundness_diff_ci_low     <- take(round_t, "ci_low")
tab$roundness_diff_ci_high    <- take(round_t, "ci_high")
tab$roundness_p_holm          <- take(round_t, "p_holm")

# Wild type is the reference row: ratios of 1 and no test.
wt_row <- tab$genotype == "Wildtype"
tab$area_ratio_vs_wt[wt_row]        <- 1
tab$area_ratio_ci_low[wt_row]       <- 1
tab$area_ratio_ci_high[wt_row]      <- 1
tab$area_change_pct[wt_row]         <- 0
tab$circularity_ratio_vs_wt[wt_row] <- 1
tab$circularity_ratio_ci_low[wt_row]  <- 1
tab$circularity_ratio_ci_high[wt_row] <- 1
tab$roundness_diff_vs_wt[wt_row]      <- 0
tab$roundness_diff_ci_low[wt_row]     <- 0
tab$roundness_diff_ci_high[wt_row]    <- 0

fmt <- function(x, digits) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "", formatC(ifelse(is.na(x), 0, x), format = "f", digits = digits))
}
fmt_p <- function(p) {
  p <- ifelse(is.na(p), 0, p)
  ifelse(is.na(p) | p == 0, "",
         ifelse(p < 0.001, formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 1),
                formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)))
}

summary_out <- data.frame(
  genotype = tab$genotype,
  system = tab$system,
  n = tab$n,
  area_mean = fmt(tab$area_mean, 0),
  area_sd = fmt(tab$area_sd, 0),
  area_geomean = fmt(tab$area_geomean, 0),
  area_ratio_vs_wt = fmt(tab$area_ratio_vs_wt, 3),
  area_ratio_ci_low = fmt(tab$area_ratio_ci_low, 3),
  area_ratio_ci_high = fmt(tab$area_ratio_ci_high, 3),
  area_change_pct = fmt(tab$area_change_pct, 1),
  area_p_holm = fmt_p(tab$area_p_holm),
  circularity_mean = fmt(tab$circularity_mean, 3),
  circularity_sd = fmt(tab$circularity_sd, 3),
  circularity_ratio_vs_wt = fmt(tab$circularity_ratio_vs_wt, 2),
  circularity_ratio_ci_low = fmt(tab$circularity_ratio_ci_low, 2),
  circularity_ratio_ci_high = fmt(tab$circularity_ratio_ci_high, 2),
  circularity_p_holm = fmt_p(tab$circularity_p_holm),
  roundness_mean = fmt(tab$roundness_mean, 3),
  roundness_sd = fmt(tab$roundness_sd, 3),
  roundness_diff_vs_wt = fmt(tab$roundness_diff_vs_wt, 3),
  roundness_diff_ci_low = fmt(tab$roundness_diff_ci_low, 3),
  roundness_diff_ci_high = fmt(tab$roundness_diff_ci_high, 3),
  roundness_p_holm = fmt_p(tab$roundness_p_holm)
)

write.csv(summary_out, "results/swarming_single_mutants_summary.csv",
          row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

## ---- secondary contrast: rhl mutants vs las mutants ----------------------

system_contrast <- function(df, var, transform, metric, scale_label) {
  las <- transform(df[[var]][df$system == "las"])
  rhl <- transform(df[[var]][df$system == "rhl"])
  tt <- t.test(rhl, las, var.equal = FALSE)
  est <- unname(tt$estimate[1] - tt$estimate[2])
  ratio <- scale_label == "ratio"
  data.frame(
    metric = metric,
    comparison = "rhl mutants vs las mutants",
    scale = scale_label,
    estimate = if (ratio) exp(est) else est,
    ci_low   = if (ratio) exp(unname(tt$conf.int[1])) else unname(tt$conf.int[1]),
    ci_high  = if (ratio) exp(unname(tt$conf.int[2])) else unname(tt$conf.int[2]),
    p_value  = tt$p.value
  )
}

sc <- rbind(
  system_contrast(sw, "area", log, "colony area", "ratio"),
  system_contrast(sw, "circularity", log, "circularity", "ratio"),
  system_contrast(sw, "roundness", identity, "roundness", "difference")
)
sc$estimate <- round(sc$estimate, 3)
sc$ci_low <- round(sc$ci_low, 3)
sc$ci_high <- round(sc$ci_high, 3)
sc$p_value <- signif(sc$p_value, 3)

write.csv(sc, "results/swarming_system_contrast.csv",
          row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

## ---- assumption checks and sensitivity analyses --------------------------

cat("Welch tests vs wild type (raw and Holm-adjusted p)\n")
cat("\nArea, log scale (estimate = log ratio)\n")
print(area_t, row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)
cat("\nCircularity, log scale (estimate = log ratio)\n")
print(circ_t, row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)
cat("\nRoundness, raw scale (estimate = mean difference)\n")
print(round_t, row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)

cat("\nLevene tests on the analysed scales\n")
print(car::leveneTest(log(area) ~ genotype, sw))
print(car::leveneTest(log(circularity) ~ genotype, sw))
print(car::leveneTest(roundness ~ genotype, sw))

cat("\nOne-way ANOVA on the analysed scales\n")
print(summary(aov(log(area) ~ genotype, sw)))
print(summary(aov(log(circularity) ~ genotype, sw)))
print(summary(aov(roundness ~ genotype, sw)))

cat("\nSensitivity: pooled-variance t-tests, Holm across the four mutants\n")
for (v in c("area", "circularity", "roundness")) {
  tr <- if (v == "roundness") identity else log
  wt <- tr(sw[[v]][sw$genotype == "Wildtype"])
  ps <- sapply(setdiff(levels(sw$genotype), "Wildtype"), function(g) {
    t.test(tr(sw[[v]][sw$genotype == g]), wt, var.equal = TRUE)$p.value
  })
  cat(v, ":", paste(sprintf("%s=%.4g", names(ps), p.adjust(ps, "holm")),
                    collapse = "  "), "\n")
}

cat("\nSensitivity: exact Wilcoxon rank-sum, each mutant vs wild type\n")
for (g in setdiff(levels(sw$genotype), "Wildtype")) {
  w <- wilcox.test(sw$area[sw$genotype == g],
                   sw$area[sw$genotype == "Wildtype"], exact = TRUE)
  cat(g, ": p =", format(w$p.value), "\n")
}

cat("\nSensitivity: Holm across all 12 comparisons\n")
p12 <- c(area_t$p_raw, circ_t$p_raw, round_t$p_raw)
names(p12) <- c(paste0("area:", area_t$genotype), paste0("circularity:", circ_t$genotype),
                paste0("roundness:", round_t$genotype))
print(sort(p.adjust(p12, method = "holm")))

## ---- figure --------------------------------------------------------------

cols <- c(WT = "#52514e", las = "#2a78d6", rhl = "#eb6834")
sys_labs <- c(WT = "Wild type", las = "las mutants", rhl = "rhl mutants")

theme_swarm <- theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "#e1e0d9", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "#c3c2b7", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "#c3c2b7", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "#52514e", size = 8),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "#0b0b0b", size = 9.5),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = "#52514e"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = "#52514e"),
    legend.key.size = unit(9, "pt"),
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

base_panel <- function(var) {
  ggplot(sw, aes(x = genotype, y = .data[[var]], colour = system)) +
    geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, seed = 1),
                size = 1.7, alpha = 0.85) +
    stat_summary(fun.data = mean_sdl, fun.args = list(mult = 1),
                 geom = "errorbar", width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.45,
                 show.legend = FALSE) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", aes(fill = system),
                 shape = 21, size = 2.8, colour = "white", stroke = 0.7,
                 show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = cols, labels = sys_labs,
                        name = "Quorum-sensing system") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols, labels = sys_labs,
                      name = "Quorum-sensing system") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c(Wildtype = "WT", "ΔlasI" = "ΔlasI",
                                "ΔlasR" = "ΔlasR", "ΔrhlI" = "ΔrhlI",
                                "rhlR-" = "rhlR-")) +
    theme_swarm
}

p_area <- base_panel("area") +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(1e4, 2e4, 5e4, 1e5),
                labels = c("10k", "20k", "50k", "100k")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(6500, 160000)) +
  labs(y = "Colony area (imaging units, log scale)")

p_circ <- base_panel("circularity") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
                     labels = c("0", "0.25", "0.5", "0.75", "1"),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(y = "Circularity")

p_round <- base_panel("roundness") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.55, 1.05), breaks = c(0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1),
                     labels = c("0.6", "0.7", "0.8", "0.9", "1.0"),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(y = "Roundness")

fig <- (p_area | p_circ | p_round) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", widths = c(1.15, 1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A",
    caption = paste("Points are individual dishes (n = 3 per genotype); bars show mean ± SD.",
                    "Colony area is on a log10 scale."),
    theme = theme(
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, colour = "#0b0b0b"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, colour = "#898781", hjust = 0)
    )
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.box = "horizontal")

value.content:
# PA14 quorum sensing and swarming

*Pseudomonas aeruginosa* PA14 coordinates collective behaviour through two quorum-sensing
systems, las and rhl. This project asks what each system contributes to swarming motility,
whether the two single mutants can rescue each other when grown together, and what the
mutants change in gene expression.

Everything here runs on this machine with R. Scripts go in `analysis/`, what they write goes
in `results/`.

## Data

| File | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| [data/swarming/single_cultures.csv](data/swarming/single_cultures.csv) | Swarming of wild type and the four single mutants, one dish per row: the colony `area` and `circularity` the imaging software reports, three replicates each. |
| [data/swarming/cocultures.csv](data/swarming/cocultures.csv) | Swarming of wild type, ΔlasI and ΔrhlI grown alone, and of ΔrhlI:ΔlasI mixes at eleven ratios from 1:3 to 1000:1, three replicates each. `ratio_rhlI_to_lasI` reads ΔrhlI first, so 10:1 is ten ΔrhlI cells per ΔlasI cell. |
| [data/rnaseq/counts.csv](data/rnaseq/counts.csv) | Raw RNA-seq counts, one row per gene and one column per sample. |
| [data/rnaseq/samples.csv](data/rnaseq/samples.csv) | What each sample column is: `Media` (MMGluFeMinus, MMGluFePlus, Succinate) × `Strain` (1 wild type, 97 ΔrhlI, 98 ΔlasI, 99 ΔlasIΔrhlI) × `Replicate` (A, B, C). |
| [data/rnaseq/annotation.csv](data/rnaseq/annotation.csv) | Each locus tag's gene name and product. |

The data come with the study
([microPublication Biology, 10.17912/micropub.biology.001326](https://doi.org/10.17912/micropub.biology.001326));
the counts and sample sheet are as distributed with it, and the annotation keeps the three
columns this project reads.

## Notes

`area` is in the units the imaging software reports, so it is compared within the assay and
never across assays. The swarming assay has three replicates per condition.

welch_vs_wt <- function(df, var, transform = identity) {
  wt <- transform(df[[var]][df$genotype == 'Wildtype'])
  muts <- setdiff(levels(df$genotype), 'Wildtype')
  res <- lapply(muts, function(g) {
    x <- transform(df[[var]][df$genotype == g])
    tt <- t.test(x, wt, var.equal = FALSE)
    data.frame(genotype = g, estimate = tt$estimate[1] - tt$estimate[2],
               ci_low = tt$conf.int[1], ci_high = tt$conf.int[2],
               df = unname(tt$parameter), p_raw = tt$p.value)
  })
  do.call(rbind, res)
}

a_log <- welch_vs_wt(sw, 'area', log)
a_log$ratio <- exp(a_log$estimate); a_log$ratio_low <- exp(a_log$ci_low); a_log$ratio_high <- exp(a_log$ci_high)
a_log$p_holm <- p.adjust(a_log$p_raw, 'holm')

c_log <- welch_vs_wt(sw, 'circularity', log)
c_log$ratio <- exp(c_log$estimate); c_log$ratio_low <- exp(c_log$ci_low); c_log$ratio_high <- exp(c_log$ci_high)
c_log$p_holm <- p.adjust(c_log$p_raw, 'holm')

r_raw <- welch_vs_wt(sw, 'roundness', identity)
r_raw$p_holm <- p.adjust(r_raw$p_raw, 'holm')

cat('--- AREA (log scale: ratio of geometric means, Welch t) ---\n')
print(a_log, digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
cat('\n--- CIRCULARITY (log scale: ratio of geometric means, Welch t) ---\n')
print(c_log, digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
cat('\n--- ROUNDNESS (raw scale: mean difference, Welch t) ---\n')
print(r_raw, digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)

cat('\n--- Alternative: pooled-variance t-tests, Holm ---\n')
for (v in c('area','circularity','roundness')) {
  tr <- if (v == 'roundness') identity else log
  wt <- tr(sw[[v]][sw$genotype == 'Wildtype'])
  ps <- sapply(setdiff(levels(sw$genotype), 'Wildtype'), function(g) {
    t.test(tr(sw[[v]][sw$genotype == g]), wt, var.equal = TRUE)$p.value })
  cat(v, ':', paste(sprintf('%s=%.4g', names(ps), p.adjust(ps, 'holm')), collapse = '  '), '\n')
}

cat('\n--- Alternative: exact Wilcoxon area, each mutant vs WT ---\n')
for (g in setdiff(levels(sw$genotype), 'Wildtype')) {
  w <- wilcox.test(sw$area[sw$genotype == g], sw$area[sw$genotype == 'Wildtype'], exact = TRUE)
  cat(g, ': p =', format(w$p.value), '\n')
}

cat('\n--- Secondary: las mutants vs rhl mutants, log area (Welch) ---\n')
las <- log(sw$area[sw$system == 'las']); rhl <- log(sw$area[sw$system == 'rhl'])
tt <- t.test(las, rhl, var.equal = FALSE)
cat(sprintf('ratio rhl/las = %.3f (95%% CI %.3f-%.3f), p = %.4g, df = %.1f\n',
            exp(tt$estimate[1]-tt$estimate[2]), exp(tt$conf.int[1]), exp(tt$conf.int[2]), tt$p.value, tt$parameter))
cat(sprintf('rhl vs las circularity ratio = %.3f, p = %.4g\n',
            exp(mean(log(sw$circularity[sw$system=='rhl'])) - mean(log(sw$circularity[sw$system=='las']))),
            t.test(log(sw$circularity[sw$system=='rhl']), log(sw$circularity[sw$system=='las']))$p.value))

cells.code:
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(dplyr); library(ggplot2)})
coc <- read.csv("data/swarming/cocultures.csv", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
coc$culture <- factor(coc$culture, levels = c("wild type", "ΔlasI", "ΔrhlI", "ΔrhlI:ΔlasI"))
mix <- subset(coc, culture == "ΔrhlI:ΔlasI")
mix$ratio <- as.numeric(sub(":.*", "", mix$ratio_rhlI_to_lasI)) /
             as.numeric(sub(".*:", "", mix$ratio_rhlI_to_lasI))
cat("rows:", nrow(coc), " conditions:", length(unique(coc$ratio_rhlI_to_lasI)), "\n")
print(coc %>% group_by(culture, ratio_rhlI_to_lasI) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), area_gm = round(exp(mean(log(area)))), area_mean = round(mean(area)),
            area_sd = round(sd(area)), circ_mean = round(mean(circularity), 3),
            round_mean = round(mean(roundness), 3), .groups = "drop") %>%
  as.data.frame(), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\npackages:", paste(c("dplyr","ggplot2","patchwork","car","boot") %in% rownames(installed.packages()), collapse = " "), "\n")
cat("ratio values in mix:", paste(sort(unique(mix$ratio)), collapse = " "), "\n")
cells.purpose: Load co-culture data and summarise each condition

cells.code:
# Compare each mix ratio with wild type and fit the ratio response
wt_area <- coc$area[coc$culture == "wild type"]
wt_circ <- coc$circularity[coc$culture == "wild type"]
wt_round <- coc$roundness[coc$culture == "wild type"]

cmp <- mix %>% group_by(ratio) %>% group_modify(~{
  tt <- t.test(log(.x$area), log(wt_area))
  tc <- t.test(log(.x$circularity), log(wt_circ))
  data.frame(n = nrow(.x),
             area_ratio = exp(unname(tt$estimate[1] - tt$estimate[2])),
             area_lo = exp(tt$conf.int[1]), area_hi = exp(tt$conf.int[2]),
             area_p = tt$p.value,
             circ_ratio = exp(unname(tc$estimate[1] - tc$estimate[2])),
             circ_p = tc$p.value)
}) %>% ungroup() %>% as.data.frame()
cmp$area_p_holm <- p.adjust(cmp$area_p, "holm")
cmp$circ_p_holm <- p.adjust(cmp$circ_p, "holm")
print(transform(cmp, area_ratio = round(area_ratio,3), area_lo = round(area_lo,2),
                area_hi = round(area_hi,2), area_p_holm = signif(area_p_holm,3),
                circ_ratio = round(circ_ratio,3), circ_p_holm = signif(circ_p_holm,3))[, -c(6,8)],
      row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)

# Quadratic model in log2 ratio, rescue window 1:3 to 100:1
win <- subset(mix, ratio >= 1/3 & ratio <= 100)
win$x <- log2(win$ratio)
m1 <- lm(log(area) ~ x, data = win)
m2 <- lm(log(area) ~ x + I(x^2), data = win)
cat("\nwindow n =", nrow(win), " ratios:", length(unique(win$ratio)), "\n")
cat("linear R2:", round(summary(m1)$r.squared, 4), " quadratic R2:", round(summary(m2)$r.squared, 4), "\n")
cat("quadratic term p:", signif(anova(m1, m2)$`Pr(>F)`[2], 3), "\n")
cf <- coef(m2)
peak_log2 <- -cf[2]/(2*cf[3]); peak <- 2^peak_log2
cat("peak ratio:", round(peak, 2), ":1   peak log2:", round(peak_log2, 3), "\n")
cat("coefficients:", paste(round(cf, 4), collapse = "  "), "\n")

# cluster bootstrap of the peak (resample dishes within ratio)
set.seed(1)
B <- 5000
boot_peak <- replicate(B, {
  idx <- unlist(lapply(split(seq_len(nrow(win)), win$ratio), function(i) sample(i, length(i), replace = TRUE)))
  cf <- coef(lm(log(area) ~ x + I(x^2), data = win[idx, ]))
  if (is.na(cf[3]) || cf[3] >= 0) NA_real_ else 2^(-cf[2]/(2*cf[3]))
})
cat("bootstrap peak median and 95% CI:", paste(round(quantile(boot_peak, c(.5,.025,.975), na.rm=TRUE), 2), collapse = "  "),
    "  (non-peak fits:", sum(is.na(boot_peak)), "of", B, ")\n")

# Same fit including the extreme 500:1 and 1000:1 ratios
mix$x <- log2(mix$ratio)
m2_all <- lm(log(area) ~ x + I(x^2), data = mix)
cf_all <- coef(m2_all)
cat("all-ratio fit R2:", round(summary(m2_all)$r.squared, 4), " peak:", round(2^(-cf_all[2]/(2*cf_all[3])), 2), "\n")

# One-way ANOVA among mix ratios (ratio effect size)
for (d in list(win = win, all = mix)) {
  a <- aov(log(area) ~ factor(ratio), data = d)
  s <- summary(a)$`Sum Sq`
  cat("ANOVA", if (nrow(d) == 30) "window" else "all", "R2 =", round(s[1]/sum(s), 4), "\n")
}

# Fitted values at window ends and peak, versus WT
cat("\nfitted gm at 1:3:", round(exp(predict(m2, newdata = data.frame(x = log2(1/3)))), 0),
    " at peak:", round(exp(predict(m2, newdata = data.frame(x = peak_log2))), 0),
    " at 100:1:", round(exp(predict(m2, newdata = data.frame(x = log2(100)))), 0),
    " | WT gm:", round(exp(mean(log(wt_area))), 0), "\n")
cells.purpose: Compare mixes with wild type and locate the response peak
